clash_yaml:
proxies:
  - name: "Edge 1. VLESS - Domain : 443"
    type: vless
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    alpn:
      - http/1.1
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    network: ws
    servername: eDgE.exAmple.com
    tls: true
    udp: true
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
    ws-opts:
      early-data-header-name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
      headers:
        Host: edge.example.com
      max-early-data: 2560
      path: /vl/9f2c1a
  - name: "Edge 2. VLESS - IPv4 : 8080"
    type: vless
    server: 104.16.0.1
    port: 8080
    network: ws
    udp: true
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
    ws-opts:
      early-data-header-name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
      headers:
        Host: edge.example.com
      max-early-data: 2560
      path: /vl/9f2c1a
  - name: VPS REALITY
    type: vless
    server: 203.0.113.10
    port: 443
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    flow: xtls-rprx-vision
    reality-opts:
      public-key: xh8kL1s5H8k6VYwB4nCq3rJ0mE9xZQ7YtA2sD4fG6hU
      short-id: 0123abcd
    servername: www.datadoghq.com
    tls: true
    udp: true
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
  - name: gRPC node
    type: vless
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    client-fingerprint: firefox
    grpc-opts:
      grpc-service-name: forge/grpc
    network: grpc
    servername: grpc.example.com
    tls: true
    udp: true
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
  - name: "Edge 1. Trojan - Domain : 443"
    type: trojan
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    alpn:
      - http/1.1
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    network: ws
    password: "p@ss w/ord+special&chars"
    udp: true
    ws-opts:
      early-data-header-name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
      headers:
        Host: edge.example.com
      max-early-data: 2560
      path: /tr/aa11
  - name: "VMess <ws> & tls"
    type: vmess
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    alpn:
      - h2
      - http/1.1
    alterId: 0
    cipher: auto
    client-fingerprint: chrome
    network: ws
    servername: vm.example.com
    tls: true
    udp: true
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
    ws-opts:
      headers:
        Host: vm.example.com
      path: /vm
  - name: VMess tcp http
    type: vmess
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    alterId: 0
    cipher: auto
    http-opts:
      headers:
        Host:
          - obfs.example.com
      method: GET
      path:
        - /index
    network: http
    udp: true
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
  - name: SS 2022
    type: ss
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    cipher: 2022-blake3-aes-128-gcm
    password: SGVsbG8gV29ybGQhIQ==
    udp: true
  - name: SS + v2ray-plugin
    type: ss
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 443
    cipher: chacha20-ietf-poly1305
    password: hunter2
    plugin: v2ray-plugin
    plugin-opts:
      host: ss.example.com
      tls: true
    udp: true
  - name: SOCKS chain
    type: socks5
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 1080
    password: pass
    udp: true
    username: user
  - name: HTTPS proxy
    type: http
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 8443
    password: "p@ss"
    sni: proxy.example.com
    tls: true
    username: user
  - name: Hy2
    type: hysteria2
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 8443
    alpn:
      - h3
    down: 200 Mbps
    hop-interval: 30
    obfs: salamander
    obfs-password: obfspw
    password: hy2pass
    ports: 20000-50000
    sni: hy2.example.com
    udp: true
    up: 50 Mbps
  - name: TUIC v5
    type: tuic
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 8444
    alpn:
      - h3
    congestion-controller: bbr
    heartbeat-interval: 10000
    password: tuicpass
    reduce-rtt: true
    sni: tuic.example.com
    udp: true
    udp-relay-mode: native
    uuid: b831381d-6324-4d53-ad4f-8cda48b30811
  - name: AnyTLS
    type: anytls
    server: edge.example.com
    port: 8445
    idle-session-check-interval: 30
    idle-session-timeout: 30
    min-idle-session: 2
    password: anytlspass
    sni: anytls.example.com
    udp: true
  - name: WARP 1
    type: wireguard
    server: 162.159.192.1
    port: 2408
    allowed-ips:
      - 0.0.0.0/0
      - "::/0"
    ip: 172.16.0.2/32
    ipv6: "2606:4700:110:8fd2::1/128"
    mtu: 1280
    persistent-keepalive: 25
    private-key: 4NyxMUme2zGv5r3QWI0hJBlNglm1J/thoCE55PK29G8=
    public-key: bmXOC+F1FxEMF9dyiK2H5/1SUtzH0JuVo51h2wPfgyo=
    reserved:
      - 55
      - 218
      - 131
    udp: true
proxy-groups:
  - name: PROXY
    type: select
    proxies:
      - "Edge 1. VLESS - Domain : 443"
      - "Edge 2. VLESS - IPv4 : 8080"
      - VPS REALITY
      - gRPC node
      - "Edge 1. Trojan - Domain : 443"
      - "VMess <ws> & tls"
      - VMess tcp http
      - SS 2022
      - SS + v2ray-plugin
      - SOCKS chain
      - HTTPS proxy
      - Hy2
      - TUIC v5
      - AnyTLS
      - WARP 1
rules:
  - "MATCH,PROXY"
